family_reports.body: They have STOLEN my boys childhood. Once happy and healthy kids, now just look lost

Many nights I have sat in defeat praying for a miracle. My little girl may never have a chance to meet her siblings, my children will grow up without their mother, I'm not sure which breaks my heart more. I just know I have to stay here, fighting a corrupt unjust system designed to destroy families for profit.
